slug: 2025-09-29 Cote d'Ivoire unveils UXP interoperability platform for secure government data sharing

facts.fact: The Minister of Digital Transition launched a public-administration interoperability platform in Abidjan on 25 September 2025 for data exchange between state information systems, built on Cybernetica's UXP and commissioned from SNDI, with a 20-month implementation alongside Digital Afrique Telecom; the document does not say it is carrying data between named bodies.

systems.owner: Ministry of Digital Transition and Digitalization; SNDI commissioned
